title: Local testing of equal pairs
statement: For every positive integer $n$, the tester that chooses an index uniformly from $\{1,\ldots,n\}$, queries the two Boolean values at that index's pair, and accepts exactly when both answers are present and equal is a local tester for strings whose values agree within every pair, with rate $1$.
hypotheses_covered: The property is equality of the two Boolean values in every indexed pair
The tester chooses its seed uniformly from the $n$ indices
The tester queries the two positions in the chosen pair
The tester accepts exactly when both answers are present and equal
